AccessType.description:
- ACCESS_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: ACCESS_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED placeholder for empty value
 - ACCESS_TYPE_NOBODY: ACCESS_TYPE_NOBODY no one can execute this
 - ACCESS_TYPE_ONLY_ADDRESS: ACCESS_TYPE_ONLY_ADDRESS only a specific address can execute
 - ACCESS_TYPE_EVERYBODY: ACCESS_TYPE_EVERYBODY everyone can execute
 - ACCESS_TYPE_ANY_OF_ADDRESSES: ACCESS_TYPE_ANY_OF_ADDRESSES any of the specified addresses can execute
AccessType.title: AccessType defines permission levels for contract code operations
